authorization.operator: 2026-10-03 grant of Path A and the executive instructions of HENRI-ARCH-2026-SYSTEMIC-EVALUATION-V3 (message body)
authorization.blueprint_item: sec 2.4 item 3: restrict outputs to strongly typed decision manifolds

receipt_gap_CLOSED: This receipt was MISSING. The run log was committed at a843e1b without a receipt pinning its numbers. Found by a content check that grepped this filename and returned empty. Recorded now.

design.readout: deterministic nearest-centroid, TRAINING-FREE (no optimizer, no lr)
design.control: per-sample block permutation of the same wave family

why_no_claim: pre-registered G-T-SUP required flat_joint < 0.80 to claim that DECOMPOSITION helps. Measured flat_joint = 0.8857. The gate does NOT fire, so no claim is made that typed decomposition beats flat on this corpus.
why_that_refusal_was_informative: a flat 512-way head at only 48 atomic ingredients clears 0.80 with a training-free readout. That contradicted the capacity sweep's flat 512-way value of 0.5449 at 512 arbitrary tokens, which is what forced ingredient_count_law_probe.py (manifold held at 512, ingredients varied 513 -> 48; raw 0.5146 -> 0.8857). The refusal produced the next experiment.

what_this_establishes_for_the_blueprint.supported: sec 2.4 item 3 in the sense that matters operationally: at typed manifold sizes the egress clears 0.80 TRAINING-FREE on held-out templates with controls at chance (tool 0.9502, arg 0.9951). Small typed manifolds are decodable.
what_this_establishes_for_the_blueprint.not_established: that decomposition is superior to a flat head at the SAME atomic vocabulary. The gate could not test that because flat also passed.
what_this_establishes_for_the_blueprint.ingredient_caveat: these heads share one corpus with 48 atomic ingredients; the 512-arbitrary-token regime is covered by the capacity sweep (0.5449), not by this run

readout_choice_justified_retroactively: This run used the training-free centroid. readout_head_to_head.py (35f22bc) later showed that choice was correct: at V=64 the centroid reaches 0.9141 while Adam training reaches only 0.4062. The training-free readout is the measured fix, not a convenience.
evidence_class: OBSERVED (real codec waves, sha256 labels, same-family control)
class: receipt written after the fact to close a provenance gap; the gate refusal is retained, not softened
